verdict.rationale: Discord documents a public REST API that apps can use to work with Discord data, authenticated by bot token or OAuth2 bearer token. It also documents a Gateway WebSocket API for events, webhooks for posting messages, and interactions such as slash commands. Probes confirm the docs are available as llms.txt and markdown for agent consumption. Missing for 10: no machine-readable OpenAPI spec was found at the probed paths, and there is no independent or hands-on corroboration of driving the product through the API.
